'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Jack Faust DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jack Faust]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' DS Deck That Makes People Lose (60 cards.)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
